heading: Shared inboxes
signOffIntro: This mailbox is shared, so emails you send from it are signed with your own name, like "{example}". Your team can see who sent each one.
signatureHint: Used instead of the mailbox's signature when you write from a shared mailbox. Leave it empty to use the mailbox's.
allInboxesHint: The newest emails from every mailbox you can open
allEmpty: Nothing in any of your inboxes
sharedHelp: For a team address like sales@ or support@. Everyone you tick can open it, and each person's emails are signed with their own name.
whoIntro: Tick everyone who should be able to open this mailbox. You can also change this from the Users page.
whoEmpty: Nobody else is on the Users list yet. Invite people from the Users page first.
